title: Unit Event — With Our Wounded Hands

meta.Outline: Ena hasn't been able to reach Mizuki since the school festival. She doesn't know what the right thing to do is, but her regrets compel her to seek Mizuki out for a heart-to-heart.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The theme of this assignment is “tranquility”, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But there's no way I can draw that right now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've sent a ton of messages since then, but none of them have been getting marked as read...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Even when I asked Akito, he said that Mizuki hasn't been to school for a while...)

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Does that mean you're also a dude?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Others at school already seem to know.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't tell you right now, but when I feel ready... I hope you'll be willing to hear me out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sometimes, talking can make things worse.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This whole time... Mizuki must've felt so scared...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And despite that, Mizuki was willing to tell me. But then...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What if I'd known what to say that time...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Because that just makes everything harder for Mizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I just uploaded the lyrics I was working on, but I don't think they'll affect your illustration much...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, I've already finished coloring it, so please have a look at that. I'll upload it now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I like it. Thank you both very much...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Yeah, sure. That's good to hear...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <In that case, I'll make some minor adjustments and export it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <At the rate we're going, we should be able to upload our song this weekend...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It would've been nice to see this as a music video, but Amia seems very busy. We'll just have to go with a still frame this time around...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Still, it's strange to not see or hear from Amia for so long. We talk almost every day, so things feel a little emptier than usual.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have no right talking about that in Mizuki's place...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It sounded like you were trying to say something just now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Anyway, let's get back to work since we have a chance to wrap things up early this time.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Then, if the lyrics seem fine to you, I'll start entering them into the video.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, go for it. They seem fine.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Is there anything else you need, K?
We have some extra time on our hands, so I can draw whatever for you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Kanade and Mafuyu wouldn't have batted an eye if they'd been the ones to learn about Mizuki.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Nothing would have changed, just like Mizuki wanted...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If these two were up there that time instead of me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Would Mizuki be here talking with us now?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki... What are you doing right now?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wonder if you're keeping in contact with someone else...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If Mizuki quits being a member of N25 and stops showing up in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We might never see each other again.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm worried sick about you, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I was hoping that Mizuki would be here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Have you seen Mizuki at all...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I caught a glimpse of Mizuki's face a couple of times when I went over to see what was going on...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I keep ending up somewhere pitch black. I think that phone's been put away in a drawer somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did you know this was gonna happen?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: At the very least, I know that this isn't what Mizuki wanted.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: To be with us like always.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We'd have pointless conversations, smile, laugh and just have fun together...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
After hearing the truth, I choked up...
I didn't know what I should say.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What if I was more mentally prepared?
What if Mizuki was the one who told me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't think that would've made a difference.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That time, if I just replied, “I didn't know that,” or, “Thanks for telling me.”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, what happens when we try going back to our normal lives? We could talk online as N25 and go out shopping together...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But a part of me would always be wondering...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can I ask? Should I ask? Would bringing it up hurt Mizuki in any way?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wouldn't be able to get it out of my mind...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which would be the worst thing for Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, MEIKO, I have a question to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What if I asked for us to meet and talk once more?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What if I said that I still want us to be friends?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is me just thinking that only going to hurt Mizuki even more...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you want to talk, you should talk.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want you to say what's on your mind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm also in the dark here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No one knows the answer to this question. Actually, you probably won't find it anywhere...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, the person you're talking about is in a fragile state. One wrong move could cause an irreparable break.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In truth, I don't want anyone to take that risk.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If we just let things proceed as is, then that's it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That is why your feelings may be the last bastion of hope for Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is it okay for me to...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You should just do what you feel the need to do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, I'm going to meet with Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We're going to meet and I'm going to say what's on my mind...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm going to say that I want us to keep being friends.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, MEIKO, please let me know if you hear any news.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to talk, but I can't get a hold of Mizuki here or in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, stop blocking the fridge for no reason. I need something out of there, so move.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you still having trouble getting ahold of Akiyama...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki still hasn't shown up for school, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I don't know exactly what's going on since we're in different classes, but Akiyama's been gone every time I go over to see Toya during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I told him to let me know if he sees Akiyama, but nothing so far...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess that's to be expected...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Want me to ask another one of Akiyama's friends?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya probably has the best idea of what's going on, but this other girl's known Akiyama a lot longer. She might've actually gotten word somehow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll arrange a meeting for you two while I'm at it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
No, I haven't heard anything...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It did feel a little odd to see Mizuki missing so much school lately.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I've gotten replies back saying, “Still not feeling it, so I'm skipping again,” and such... Which I guess means things are okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. At least someone's been able to get in contact...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hang on... Does that mean you haven't been able to get ahold of Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, would you like it if I asked Mizuki to get in touch with you...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If she were to use my name...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki might stop replying to Shiraishi altogether, which would mean...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, I'll need to give that some more thought.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay.
Feel free to ask again if you need any help!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks, I will.
And sorry for making you meet with me like this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, that's okay! I was also a little worried about Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Not replying to anything I send must mean...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki doesn't want to talk to me.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hello, Shinonome.
It's rare to bump into you at school like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Is something wrong...?
You seem rather concerned.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm thinking about telling them everything...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: About myself. To the others in my group.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you'd like, I'd be more than happy to listen.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...and you haven't been able to get a hold of Mizuki at all?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
We spoke a little during the school festival...
But we haven't talked since then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But Shiraishi's gotten some replies back, so I guess that means I'm being avoided...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I have to think Mizuki doesn't want me running around playing detective like this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I can't just leave things be...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because if I do, Mizuki will...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's why I want us to talk.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I don't think I'm in a position to support or stop you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But if you'll allow me to talk about myself for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've gone through a similar experience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Someone I had tried to distance myself away from forced his way through and broke down my walls.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There was a point when I thought his persistence and pushiness were irritating. And now, we're walking down the same path...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Upon reflection, I think that was exactly what I needed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
However, at the time, I wondered why he was being so pushy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm just speaking from my own personal experience. It may not entirely apply to what you and Mizuki are currently going through, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Particularly since the old Mizuki would've told anyone who tried to help to go away and severed ties with them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't know if I should be telling you this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the old Mizuki... The person I met was always all alone...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, Mizuki and I went to the same junior high school. We first met up on the rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, I was also alone because I had trouble getting along with others...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And Mizuki was in the same situation.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Back then, unlike now, Mizuki did not like being around others. You could sense that there was this barrier...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'd speak whenever we saw each other on the rooftop, but only momentarily...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, it was enough to give me an understanding.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I could tell that the two of us were very similar creatures.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Somewhere in our hearts, we felt this loneliness.

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Does that mean you're also a dude?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What if others have been viewing Mizuki that way for years...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What if people have been saying mean things or asking insensitive questions all this time?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just how much has Mizuki had to suffer...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The old Mizuki likely would never have budged, no matter how hard you tried to help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But now...
I honestly can't say one way or the other.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki has changed since meeting all of you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've seen real laughter. Nothing forced like before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I've found real friends and a place where I belong.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I think Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...hoped for a future that includes all of you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: At the very least, I know that this isn't what Mizuki wanted.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't know if that's all in the past now, or if it's still affecting things in the present.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a friend, I want Mizuki to look forward to the future.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I want to believe in your bravery and your wishes for Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And above all else, I want to believe that Mizuki still wishes for a future that includes all of you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If there's still a way for us to connect...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Then I don't want things to end this way...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Because I still want us to be friends!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What brings you all here today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The new demo's finished, so we were hoping to listen to it with you and the others, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, really...?
I can't wait to hear what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, still too busy it seems.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I tried going everywhere I thought Mizuki would be multiple times since then...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Has Mizuki just been at home this whole time...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Asking Shiraishi to help is sorta my last resort, but I don't think I have a choice at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You've been like this ever since Mizuki stopped showing up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can't tell you guys much, but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is there anything I can do to help?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But it must be serious if it's causing you so much distress, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I'd like to help if I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because you and Mizuki are both valued members of N25...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to help as well...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because Mizuki never showing up again would be a problem.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I am somewhat responsible for what happened, after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'd like to help as well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In that case, would you all mind helping me find Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I want us to talk, but my calls and messages have all gone unanswered...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But do you have a search plan?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, Mizuki hasn't replied at all, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can possibly try getting a hold of Mizuki through a friend at school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if that doesn't go well, it might end up making things worse...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go to the places where we'd normally find Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess that's our only option...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But that's gonna be hard since it's a lot of ground to cover...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have everyone's help this time. I'm not alone.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this, you two...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No...
I was hoping going to the sewing lounge would help since Mizuki seems to spend a lot of time there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Then, Kanade, do you know if there are any fabric shops around here?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Fabric shops? I'm not sure.
I can try doing a quick search...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Mizuki's been wanting to go to this new one since it's supposed to be really cute.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Then, I'll try finding what I can on it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This seemed like the right time to catch everyone going home, but I have no way of telling if Mizuki's even at school.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it has.
Are you waiting for someone?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, actually...
I was in the neighborhood and hoping to see Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Akiyama wasn't at school today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you for letting me know.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Actually, Aoyagi, there's something I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was so sure this company's latest release would be the perfect draw.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I might just need to wait.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At least until the evening. That could be my chance...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But if we don't see each other...
Then that means Mizuki's all alone somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I still couldn't really get my head around it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I don't have the courage to just disappear either.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And yet, I don't see the point in living.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which is why watching anime like this works, because...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't have to think about anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder if Ena's still trying to get a hold of me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I've been logged out of Nightcord ever since that day, so I really don't know.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What happened to keeping your distance from us...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Are you not coming back to SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We've been to all the usual places we could come up with, but it is possible that we keep just missing each other...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How do you know that Mizuki's left home at all...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's all we can do right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If only we could reach Mizuki's phone somehow.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: B-But you said you always ended up somewhere pitch black whenever you tried going over to Mizuki's phone...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I managed to pop in when it was actually in use.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And we had a chance to talk a little.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, where's Mizuki been all this time?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: For a few days at the very least...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Supplementary classes. Although, I'm not sure Mizuki's actually going to show up for them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I happened to run into Aoyagi during my search.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Based on my conversation with him, Mizuki's missed enough days to have to attend supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I remember hearing something about having to attend supplementary classes or risk being held back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Considering how Mizuki's just barely been staying in contact with Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm guessing it has something to do with not wanting others to worry.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki's worried that getting held back would cause trouble for everyone?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's true that Mizuki might be feeling that way, and it would explain those messages with Shiraishi. Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is Mizuki really going to show up...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I have to take whatever I can at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks, Mafuyu.
I'll try asking the teachers about those supplementary classes!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm really sorry, but would you keep being by Mizuki's side if possible?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I've got things covered here.
Thanks again for coming.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But still no sign...
Mizuki seems to come here just after noon, so we can probably expect to keep waiting until the last minute.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Voice
rows.Line: <Okay. In that case, I'll stay near the school gate a little while longer.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you skip school like this, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Voice
rows.Line: <It's okay. This is far more important.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll let you know if something happens.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Today's when the teachers said there'd be supplementary classes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've been looking all over for Mizuki since then, but we never once saw each other.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, today might be my biggest chance...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Those supplementary classes are supposed to take place after school, so Mizuki should, in theory, be arriving soon.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I'm going to maximize my odds, should I wait by the main entrance instead of by this classroom?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know, but I'd rather not miss my chance by moving around needlessly.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But this is basically my last shot.
I have to bet everything on it.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But is this really what I'm supposed to be doing...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Sorry, you two.
I have a huge favor to ask...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I did miss a lot of days.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Still, I'd rather not get held back...
And make my family worry even more about me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There's a chance that Ena's gonna be at school...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (An and Toya are also probably pretty worried... If they start asking me stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess I have to give up...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(It goes on sale today?
I had no idea.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I had a feeling that you'd stop by here if you didn't feel like going in for your supplementary classes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You love Dear Ribbon...
So I thought you'd naturally gravitate towards their new releases.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What do I do?! What do I do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This is how things have to be...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I just have to keep running, lose her and...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Run if that is what you really want to do.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But this may be your last chance to talk to everyone.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Or at the very least, to Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't want either to happen...!!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Please...!
Talk to me... Just for a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ever since that day, I haven't been able to stop thinking...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I keep asking myself what I could've said instead or how I really should've reacted. I keep wondering if you wouldn't have run away if I had...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I keep wondering what I could've done better...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: To be honest, I don't even know if confronting you here like this is the best option...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I know you don't want me thinking about what's right or wrong or whatever... I get that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I want us to stay friends!
Which means it's natural that I'd want to make the right choice!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You know how I am...!
Once I regret something, I dwell on it forever!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I understand that my way of doing things could end up hurting you even more! But... But...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm doing this because I still want us to be friends moving forward...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You've gotta at least know that!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, you're already having trouble dealing with what you've learned...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Moving forward, you're gonna worry and not know how to talk to me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So I think being around me isn't such a good idea...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No...!
I'm not about to end things here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You don't want to either, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You've stopped running and avoiding me, which tells me that you don't want things to end here...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't want us to go our separate ways...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If something I'm doing is causing you harm, then I'll do my best to stop.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know that makes you feel like you're being pitied...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But I don't want to hurt you.
That's the clear and honest truth!
That's never ever going to change!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because you're my dear friend, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why are you able to say that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't you know that being my friend means having to tiptoe around a lot of stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You might see people looking at me funny... People who we don't know at all might begin spreading nasty rumors about us...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What happens then, Ena...?
Are you still going to treat me the same...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because even though I can't bear to, I would be looking at your reaction every time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If we end it here, you won't have to worry about that! I mean, Ena, you...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't care what happens to me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't care what other people say or how hard it's going to be to deal with all this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because never seeing you again would hurt more!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't know if I'll be able to accept the kindness you and the others are going to give me at face value...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And it's gonna turn into a never-ending cycle...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sick and tired of feeling this pain...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's going to hurt every time you all try to be nice to me...! I'll keep thinking why it has to be like this...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm going to wonder, “Is it even okay for us to keep being friends?” I know I am...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And if us staying friends means having to suffer...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then...!
We should just say goodbye to each other now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you mean, “Is it okay for us to keep being friends”...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm saying you're wrong about wondering if it's okay for us to be friends, because that question doesn't make any sense to begin with!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Have you been listening?! I still consider you my friend! Or do you mean you don't think of me as yours?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, if we really still are friends, then don't make decisions for me by yourself...!!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Get it through your thick skull, will you...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Between that day and now, I've thought long and hard about what you're going through! I even learned a few new things along the way!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're the one who's changed, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've been trying to talk to you, but you haven't been listening...! You've just been running away...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you're seriously wondering if it's okay for us to keep being friends?! To me, that sounds really stupid because...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You have been and always will be my dear friend!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is that at least getting through to you?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was surprised, but even so, it's the absolute truth...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's everything I wanted to say...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you still feel like leaving, then I'm not gonna stop you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because that's probably what'll make you the happiest...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Run if that is what you really want to do.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But this may be your last chance to talk to everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: ...for me to be friends with all of you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm going to get scared again...
I'm going to want to run away...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know it's going to happen...!
I'm going to be backed into a corner!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to feel like I belong...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I still want us to be friends...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's all I've ever wanted...!
Friends who accept me for who I am...! Friends who feel comfortable around me...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But no matter how hard I tried, I just couldn't tell you...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I'm not sure things will ever get better...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is it really okay for someone like me...to still be friends with you?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Again, your question doesn't make any sense.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You have to decide for yourself, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because... I really don't wanna have to chase after you like this again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm gonna cause you a lot of trouble...!
I might end up having really bad days...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wanna keep belonging...! I want us to stay friends...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: N25's been waiting for you to come back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry for making you all worry.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell all of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something you guys have to hear...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something I've been wanting to say.
